name: strad-server-onepassword
description: 1Password MCP server packaged as a strad supplementary-image bundle (streamable-HTTP over the shared/ tool logic, with the op CLI baked into the image).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pulsemcp/mcp-elicitation && npm run build --workspace onepassword-mcp-server-shared && npm run build --workspace onepassword-mcp-server-remote
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts

comments.layout: Three workspaces built in dependency order. `elicitation/` is @pulsemcp/mcp-elicitation, vendored from pulsemcp/mcp-servers libs/elicitation because it is NOT published to npm (shared/ imports it). `shared/` is the upstream tool logic, vendored verbatim. `remote/` is the only new logic: a streamable-HTTP entrypoint over shared/. The op CLI is NOT an npm dependency — it is a binary baked into the Docker image and invoked via child_process; see Dockerfile.
